section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single cross-sectional study (Study X) examining body appreciation in 387 emerging adult women aged 18-25. The study assessed early memories of warmth with peers, self-compassion, social safeness, body appreciation, and disordered eating through self-report questionnaires, finding that positive peer experiences and self-compassion were associated with higher body appreciation and lower disordered eating.
